stem:
The tables of ordered pairs represent some points on the graphs of two different lines.

Line a

| x | -11 | -6 | -1 | 4 |
| y | 81  | 51 | 21 | -9 |

Line b

| x | -9 | -4 | 1 | 6 |
| y | 18 | 3 | -12 | -27 |

Which system of equations represents the graph of these two lines?
visual_elements: Line a table: x values: -11, -6, -1, 4 | y values: 81, 51, 21, -9
Line b table: x values: -9, -4, 1, 6 | y values: 18, 3, -12, -27
